_doc: Cross-agent parity matrix for the four plugin adapters (claude, codex, cursor, gemini). The native and API adapters (opencode, pi, devin) are not in it. Each feature: title, group, adapters {adapter: 'present' | 'limit:<citation>' | 'na:<reason>'}, probes {adapter: probe or [probes]} for the present cells. Optional: notes {adapter: text} qualifying a present cell (e.g. notify-only), and outside_matrix {opencode|pi|devin: 'na:<reason>' | 'limit:<citation>'} saying why an adapter outside the matrix lacks the feature. Probe kinds: hook {event, command regex, matcher regex?, tool?}, skill {name}, script {path}, agent {path}, mcp {server}, grep {path, pattern}; paths are relative to adapters/<adapter>/. Checked by tests/test_parity_matrix.py; docs/parity.md is generated by build/parity_md.py.

investigation_bootstrap.title: Investigation bootstrap and binding at session start

owner_input_capture.title: Owner-input capture (what the owner typed, shared gate)

owner_input_disclosure.title: Owner-input disclosure, per session, before the first capture

adapters.cursor: limit:Cursor has no user-visible, non-blocking hook message: beforeSubmitPrompt's user_message shows only when the prompt is blocked, and the other outputs are model context (https://cursor.com/docs/agent/hooks; adapters/cursor/README.md#owner-input-opt-in-consent). Compensated by the connect-time, versioned consent (owner_input_consent).

owner_input_consent.title: Owner-input consent given in the user's terminal (cardinal-connect --owner-input)

adapters.claude: na:capture follows the per-session disclosure (plan R3); no separate consent is required
adapters.codex: na:capture follows the per-session disclosure (plan R3); no separate consent is required
adapters.gemini: na:capture follows the per-session disclosure (plan R3); no separate consent is required

owner_input_flush.title: Owner-input outbox flushed at turn end

advisory_tool_boundary.title: Advisory delivery at a tool boundary (staged items, then the inbox)

advisory_subagent_guard.title: A subagent's tool call does not consume the main thread's advisories

adapters.cursor: limit:the guard is coded (a payload naming agent_id / subagent_id gets nothing), but Cursor documents no subagent id on tool hooks (https://cursor.com/docs/agent/hooks; adapters/cursor/README.md#investigation-sessions), so a subagent's tool call may be delivered the advisories.
adapters.gemini: limit:AfterTool carries no agent id and subagents run tools through the same hooks; Gemini CLI has no subagent hook events (gemini-cli 0.50.0 HookEventName, chunk-W4YMYD53.js:324340-324352; adapters/gemini/README.md#limits).

turn_end_delivery.title: Turn end: inbox, sync check when the poller is stale, supervision stop, decision reminders

turn_end_block.title: Turn-end deliveries block the stop in the same turn (else staged for the next boundary)

adapters.cursor: limit:stop's followup_message is submitted as the next user message, so advisory text would become owner input (plan R1; https://cursor.com/docs/agent/hooks; adapters/cursor/README.md#limits-on-cursor). Staged for the next postToolUse or sessionStart instead.
adapters.gemini: limit:an AfterAgent block re-enters the model as plain user-role text and re-fires BeforeAgent with the reason as the prompt (gemini-cli 0.50.0 chunk-W4YMYD53.js:335749-335757; adapters/gemini/README.md#limits). Staged for the next BeforeAgent or AfterTool instead.

session_guidance.title: Session guidance text (links, question, checkpoint, ACK/POST, SUPERVISION), one shared builder

labeled_links.title: Labeled links (Storyboard private draft; Investigation timeline)

investigation_failures_observe.title: A recording command that could not reach Cardinal is reported

preview_render.title: Preview auto-render to local PNGs (plus cover and unfurl mock)

hero_upload.title: Hero render uploaded on publish (link previews)

evidence_token.title: Evidence token stored from create / add_act / preview

edit_lookup.title: Edit lookup: storyboards about a file the agent edits

context_stamping.title: Context stamping on storyboard tools (session_id, context filled automatically)

adapters.codex: limit:Codex applies a PreToolUse updatedInput only together with permissionDecision "allow", which may skip the approval prompt, so the hook stamps only in bypassPermissions mode or with CARDINAL_STORYBOARD_CONTEXT=always; elsewhere the agent passes cardinal-storyboard context (adapters/codex/README.md#storyboard-associations; https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/hooks).
adapters.cursor: limit:beforeMCPExecution answers with a permission (allow / deny / ask) and cannot rewrite the call's input (https://cursor.com/docs/agent/hooks; adapters/cursor/README.md#storyboard-associations). The sessionStart text and the cardinal-storyboard context CLI are used instead.

discovery_session_start.title: Related storyboards shown at session start

discovery_relook_prompt.title: Discovery re-look on a prompt when the branch or HEAD moved

discovery_subagent_start.title: Discovery block handed to a subagent at its start

adapters.cursor: limit:subagentStart answers {permission, user_message} only, with no additional_context (https://cursor.com/docs/agent/hooks; adapters/cursor/README.md#limits-on-cursor). Staged items still reach the subagent at its first postToolUse.
adapters.gemini: limit:Gemini CLI has no SubagentStart / SubagentStop hook event (gemini-cli 0.50.0 HookEventName, chunk-W4YMYD53.js:324340-324352; adapters/gemini/README.md#limits).

connect_hint_stray_key.title: Connect hint (unconnected) and stray-key warning at session start

decision_skill.title: decision skill (status, and how to toggle capture)

evidence_capture.title: Evidence capture of every tool call (local spool, scrubbed)

evidence_capture_failure.title: Evidence capture of a failed tool call

adapters.codex: limit:Codex has no tool-failure hook event; a failed call that reaches PostToolUse (a shell command's non-zero exit) is captured, one that does not is not (adapters/codex/README.md#evidence-capture-storyboards; https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/hooks).

evidence_promote.title: cardinal-evidence CLI (promote what a storyboard cites)

checks_skill_template.title: Checks skill template over the shared common/checks core

checks_session_reconcile.title: Session start reconciles the installed checks skill and adds the routing rule

checks_skill_deny.title: The checks skill is denied while the preview is off

adapters.codex: limit:Codex has no skill tool call to deny: it lists the plugin's skills when the session starts and the model opens a SKILL.md itself; a running session keeps the list it started with (adapters/codex/README.md#checks-preview-opt-in; https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/hooks).
adapters.cursor: limit:no Cursor hook event names a skill being used, so there is nothing to deny; a change applies to sessions started afterwards (https://cursor.com/docs/agent/hooks; adapters/cursor/README.md#limits-on-cursor).

checks_skill_reload.title: A checks on / off change is picked up by the running session (skill reload)

adapters.codex: limit:a Codex SessionStart hook can only add context, with no skill-reload output; on / off apply to sessions started afterwards (adapters/codex/README.md#checks-preview-opt-in; https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/hooks).
adapters.cursor: limit:Cursor's sessionStart output is additional_context (and env), with no skill-reload field; on / off apply to sessions started afterwards (https://cursor.com/docs/agent/hooks; adapters/cursor/README.md#limits-on-cursor).
adapters.gemini: limit:Gemini CLI loads an extension's skills when it loads the extension and no hook output can reload them; the user can type /skills reload (gemini-cli 0.63.0 chunk-ED56GFWH.js:101678; adapters/gemini/README.md#limits).

checks_range_follow.title: Following a range run (Claude: Monitor; elsewhere: polling get_behavior_range)

git_state.title: cardinal.git_state on each prompt (repo, branch, PR, initiative)

spend_limits_notice_at_prompt.title: Spend-limits warn / notify shown with the prompt

adapters.cursor: limit:beforeSubmitPrompt has no context output ({continue, user_message} only), so warn / notify are staged and surface at the next postToolUse (https://cursor.com/docs/agent/hooks; adapters/cursor/README.md#session-context--spend-limits).

initiative_convention.title: Initiative branch-naming convention and budget standing at session start

decision_context_per_prompt.title: Decision-capture instructions and ledger refreshed on each prompt

adapters.cursor: limit:beforeSubmitPrompt cannot add context, so the instructions and the decisions so far arrive once, at sessionStart (https://cursor.com/docs/agent/hooks; adapters/cursor/README.md#decision-capture-opt-in).

limit:Cursor's hook surface and transcript expose no per-model-call token counts (https://forum.cursor.com/t/accessing-the-full-agent-transcript-in-cursor/157311; adapters/cursor/README.md#telemetry-scope).
limit:no token counts at all on Cursor (https://forum.cursor.com/t/accessing-the-full-agent-transcript-in-cursor/157311; adapters/cursor/README.md#telemetry-scope).
adapters.gemini: limit:cached-content tokens are not exposed to Gemini CLI hooks (AfterModel usageMetadata), so cost ignores cache discounts (adapters/gemini/README.md#telemetry-scope).
limit:Gemini CLI has no subagent stop event; AfterAgent fires once per main-agent turn (gemini-cli 0.50.0 HookEventName, chunk-W4YMYD53.js:324340-324352; adapters/gemini/README.md#telemetry-scope).

adapters.cursor: limit:Cursor's common hook fields (conversation and generation ids, model, Cursor version, workspace roots, user email, transcript path) carry no subscription plan or rate-limit tier (https://cursor.com/docs/agent/hooks; adapters/cursor/README.md#telemetry-scope).

limit:Cursor's hook payloads carry no rate-limit utilization; the plugin's plan_usage on Cursor is a context-window slice from preCompact (https://cursor.com/docs/agent/hooks; adapters/cursor/README.md#telemetry-scope).
adapters.gemini: limit:gemini-cli reads subscription quota itself through the Code Assist retrieveUserQuota RPC (gemini-cli 0.63.0 chunk-IVQKNOQE.js:retrieveUserQuota) with the user's Google OAuth credentials and passes it to no hook; the plugin does not reuse the user's Google token against that internal API. plan_usage carries only the PreCompress compaction slice (adapters/gemini/README.md#telemetry-scope)
